top_signals.title: Seesaw Day for Markets, Anthropic IPO Looms
top_signals.summary:
Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Doubleline’s Global Sovereign and Emerging Markets Head Bill Campbell, Csis’ Senior Fellow Henrietta Levin, Former SEC Chair Gary Gensler, Omni Federal’s General Manager of AI and Edge Jana Eggers, Morgan Stanley Private Wealth Management’s Executive Director Katerina Simonetti, Willkie Farr and Gallagher’s Capital Markets Practice Co-Chair Edward Best, Citi’s Chair and CEO Jane Fraser, Salesforce’s Former AI CEO Clara Shih, Harbor Capital Advisors’ Portfolio Manager Justin Menne.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
